resources.label: tokui
resources.description: Interactive TUI over tokei's statistics.
resources.nextAction: Run `tokei -o json | tokui` in a repo.

resources.label: uv
resources.description: Python package and project manager — the python skills assume it.
resources.nextAction: Run `uv init` in a Python project.

resources.label: agent-browser
resources.description: Browser automation CLI the browser-usage and e2e test skills drive.
resources.nextAction: Ask your agent to test a website.

resources.label: mermaid-cli
resources.description: Renders Mermaid diagrams to images (mmdc) — used by the diagram skills.
resources.nextAction: Ask your agent for a diagram.

resources.label: marp-cli
resources.description: Renders Markdown slide decks — used by the marp-slide skill.
resources.nextAction: Ask your agent for a slide deck.

resources.label: beads
resources.description: Beads (br): local-first issue tracker for coding agents — tasks in SQLite with JSONL export for git. Rust port of Steve Yegge's beads.
resources.nextAction: Run `br quickstart` in a repo.

resources.label: beads-viewer
resources.description: Beads viewer (bv): graph-aware TUI over the Beads tracker — kanban, dependency DAG, critical path.
resources.nextAction: Run `bv` in a repo with Beads issues.

resources.label: glab-tui
resources.description: Terminal UI for GitLab and GitHub on top of glab/gh: issues, MRs, pipelines, runners, releases.
resources.nextAction: Run `glab-tui` in a repo with a GitLab or GitHub remote.

resources.label: gitleaks
resources.description: Secret scanner for git repos - catches committed credentials before they ship.
resources.nextAction: Run `gitleaks git` in a repo.

resources.label: zoxide
resources.description: Smarter cd that learns your habits: `z` jumps to frecent directories, `zi` picks interactively.
resources.nextAction: Add `eval "$(zoxide init zsh)"` to your shell profile, then `z <dir>`.

resources.label: envx
resources.description: Environment variable manager with a TUI and CLI. Native binaries on Linux/Windows; builds via cargo on macOS (crates.io `envex`).
resources.nextAction: Run `envx` to browse your environment.

resources.label: pup
resources.description: Datadog API CLI for agents and humans: 200+ commands over metrics, logs, monitors, traces.
resources.nextAction: Run `pup auth login` once.

resources.label: plannotator
resources.description: Browser-based plan and code review for coding agents, with figure-led Guided Reviews: one document, a code peek, and in-app guides drawn by the changeset-walkthrough skill. The plannotator skills drive it.
resources.nextAction: In Claude Code run `/plugin marketplace add Yassimba/plannotator` and `/plugin install plannotator@plannotator`, then restart. Pick changeset-walkthrough in loom to get the figure-led guides.

resources.label: claude-obsidian
resources.description: An Obsidian vault as your agent's wiki: wiki-ingest, wiki-query, save, think, canvas, and the autoresearch loop, with a source-grounded Python core. By AgriciDaniel, MIT.
resources.nextAction: In Claude Code run `/plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian` and `/plugin install claude-obsidian@agricidaniel-claude-obsidian`, then `/claude-obsidian:wiki`. Other agents load its skills from `$(mise where github:AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian)/skills`.
